attributes.title: 2027 NASW West Virginia Hybrid Spring Social Work Conference
attributes.series: NASW West Virginia Spring Social Work Conference
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, West Virginia Chapter
attributes.summary:
The West Virginia Chapter of NASW runs its 2027 spring conference Wednesday through Friday, April 14 to 16, 2027, at the Charleston Coliseum & Convention Center, with a hybrid option for those who cannot travel. The chapter has run this meeting each spring as its main CE conference for social workers in the state; the 2025 edition was billed as the Spring CE Conference for Social Workers.

The 2027 program, CE hour total and fee amounts are not published yet. Early-bird registration is open through December 31, 2026, and session proposals are accepted until November 15, 2026.

Exhibitors and sponsors register separately, with an early discount code listed on the chapter page.
